dateBasis.evidence: SOR/2022-220 section 7 amends CEC; section 10 brings those amendments into force on 2022-11-16.
dateBasis.limitation: This is not the start date of CEC, not the date every requirement was introduced, and not the page modification date. Review uses current requirements as if applying today; no historical replay is validated.

sources.decodingIssue: Response bytes do not match declared encoding; raw snapshot retained without replacement or transcoding.

Keep calendar/partial-week boundary uncertainty visible. Do not interpret met as full CEC eligibility, an occupational restriction clearance, language/admissibility approval, CRS or an invitation.
operationalStepsAfterApproval: Write a separate approved local policy bundle without changing the draft.
